items.title: How much engineering time is at risk if the assumption is wrong?
items.description: Drag the number of weeks spent building the full feature before checking the underlying assumption. If the assumption turns out wrong, every week already spent is wasted — while a cheap validation test costs a fixed 0.5 work weeks (a rough way to show L3's 2-day fake-door test plus review time) no matter when it happens, since that cost doesn't depend on this slider. At 6 weeks, this reproduces L1's actual case; at 0, it reproduces L3's validate-first approach.

params.name: weeksBuildBeforeValidating
params.label: Weeks of full-feature engineering before validating
